{{Top}}
'''Magrifle''' was a generic term used to describe any [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]-like weapon that used electromagnetic energy to fire a projectile at a target. Magrifles were distinguished by the coils that wound around their [[Barrel/Legends|barrels]], in order to produce the necessary magnetic force to propel a projectile away from the weapon.
